    # Put the minimum directly below the 1 so the down branch (i != n-1) matters
    grid2 = [
        [9, 9, 8],
        [9, 1, 9],
        [9, 7, 9],
    ]
    # neighbors: up=9, left=9, down=7, right=9 -> min 7
    assert minPath(grid2, 4) == [1, 7, 1, 7]
    assert minPath(grid2, 3) == [1, 7, 1]


def test_min_path_one_at_top_left_corner():
    """1 at (0, 0): skips i != 0 and j != 0 branches."""
    grid = [
        [1, 3],
        [8, 2],
    ]
    # neighbors: right=3, down=8 -> min 3
    assert minPath(grid, 2) == [1, 3]

        [8, 1],
    ]
    # neighbors: left=8, up=3 -> min 3
    assert minPath(grid, 2) == [1, 3]
